name: Rucking
instructions: Load a weight vest or rucksack with a plate or sandbag, positioned high and close to the shoulders.
Stand tall with the chest up, shoulders back, and core braced.
Walk at a brisk, sustainable pace on flat or varied terrain.
Maintain a normal stride length rather than overstriding to compensate for the load.
Continue for the target time or distance, keeping posture consistent throughout.
